title: Montagnier DNA water teleportation confirmed in witnessed experiments
plain: A guest named Dave Rossi tells Michels he has watched lab experiments that confirm a paper by the scientist Luc Montagnier, which claimed that the signature of DNA could be sent into water and copied there, an effect Rossi calls "teleportation." Rossi says he saw these experiments himself in private laboratories, and if he is right, genetic information can pass from place to place without any physical material moving.
